A note from me to you

Read this slowly, my favourite girl.

Please ignore my mistakes in this letter and in life. I make some silly mistakes here and there, but will never hurt you ever.

You already know how much i love you ❤️ how much i adore you like a small child in a candy shop. My eyes adore your beauty but my soul adore your heart.

Yours, Jayyy ♡
